lines.zh: 我穿过欧兰伍德的树影。
lines.en: I pass through the Ouranwood's shadows.
My antlers are broad, like branches.

lines.zh: 我走起来很快，几乎不响。
lines.en: I move fast, almost silently.
I cross the leaves and none of them crack.
I follow the old path through the wood.

lines.zh: 欧兰伍德森林的鹿角很宽。
lines.en: Ouranwood stags carry wide antlers.
My hooves land surely.

lines.zh: 欧兰伍德的鹿，从树间穿过。
lines.en: Ouranwood deer slip between trunks.
Every step I take, I get faster.
The wind is at my back.
I circle the clearing halfway.
Then I charge.
I stand with leaves caught in my antlers.

lines.zh: 我在听林子里有没有别的东西。
lines.en: I'm listening for anything else in the wood.

lines.zh: 我这双眼睛，背后也能看到一点。
lines.en: With these eyes I can almost see behind me.
The whole wood smells of me.
I lower my head and paw the soil.
It leaves a shallow line.
I raise my head and turn an ear.

lines.zh: 我竖起耳朵，风里有动静。
lines.en: I prick my ears; something moves in the wind.

lines.zh: 我朝林边的响动转过角。
lines.en: I swing my antlers toward the sound.

lines.zh: 我身上有一点加速的力气。
lines.en: There's a speed in me, waiting.

lines.zh: 这片林子是我的，你踩进来了。
lines.en: This forest is mine, and you walked into it.

lines.zh: 这里的树，都是我看着长的。
lines.en: I've watched all these trees grow.

lines.zh: 你踩的那片叶子，我认得。
lines.en: I know that leaf you stepped on.
You don't smell of the wood.

lines.zh: 所以你不在我的林子里。
lines.en: So you aren't in my wood.
You're only standing on top of it.

lines.zh: 我低头，是准备用角顶你。
lines.en: I lower my head to bring my antlers up.
Not to graze.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了一片叶子，退了。
lines.en: You crushed a leaf and stepped back.
You stood still instead of running.
I step back and my antlers are askew.
I shake my head and they straighten.

lines.zh: 这一撞太沉，我的腿软了。
lines.en: That blow was too heavy; my legs give.

lines.zh: 肩上挨了一下，我照样跑。
lines.en: A blow to my shoulder, and I keep running.

lines.zh: 血顺着鹿毛滴在落叶上。
lines.en: Blood drips from my fur onto the leaves.
I've scattered a patch of leaves.
I snort, and white breath comes out.

lines.zh: 鹿皮上多了道口子，不碍事。
lines.en: A new cut in my hide; nothing serious.
My antlers are still up. So am I.
Ouranwood deer with sharp antlers.
What's in your hand smells of grass.

lines.zh: 欧兰伍德的影子里，我站着。
lines.en: In Ouranwood shade, I stand.
Not the grass from here.
My teeth meet the grass and bite.
This taste is wrong.
Cud drops from my mouth.

lines.zh: 欧兰伍德的林子，我熟每条道。
lines.en: I know every trail in the Ouranwood.
I don't much like being fed.
I find my own grass in this wood.
This wood is enough for me.

lines.zh: 你撞在我肩上，被顶开了。
lines.en: You hit my shoulder and are shoved aside.
My antler grazes your arm.
That'll bruise.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，蹄子陷进土。
lines.en: I step back and my hoof sinks into soil.
You're a little quicker than I expected.
But you can't outrun this wood.
I bring my antlers round to the front.
My antlers point at you.
You've stopped moving.
I hit you, and my antlers catch.
My herd waits for me under the trees.
They walk slower than I do.
I'm not often with them.

lines.zh: 格利默生下来，就是这个样子。
lines.en: Glimmer is born looking like this.
Other deer avoid me.
I watch them from behind the trees.
They graze. I wait.

lines.zh: 这片林子，终究会只剩我一个。
lines.en: In the end this wood will be only me.
That's all right.
Trees don't walk away.
I lower my head and bite the grass.
Two chews and I swallow.
The grass here is bland.
I bite this branch clean through.
There's fallen fruit on the ground.
I sniff it and leave it.
That fruit is overripe.

lines.zh: 我叼起鹿肉，接着往前走。
lines.en: I take up the venison and walk on.
Less grass ahead.
But it's quieter.
Someone's at the wood's edge.
Carrying something.
He's coming this way.
I press my neck down.
Antlers aimed forward.
I press the soil firm under my hooves.

lines.zh: 林间一步，我就能顶到你。
lines.en: One forest step and my antlers reach you.
In these woods I smelled you first.

lines.zh: 我踏出树影，朝你冲过去。
lines.en: I step out of the shade and charge.
A leaf sounds under my hoof.
He looked up and saw.
He's seen me at last.
Then no more courtesies.
I break into a run.
The speed is in me now.

lines.zh: 林边有个人，我越跑越快。
lines.en: Someone at the forest edge; I run faster.
I run around the clearing.
He's hiding behind trees.
Trees don't stop antlers.

lines.zh: 我侧过角，从树缝里挤过。
lines.en: I turn my antlers and squeeze the gap.
He backs deeper into the wood.
It's darker deep in the wood.
The dark suits me better.
My feet know this ground.
His don't.
He stumbled.

lines.zh: 再一步，我就能撞到你了。
lines.en: One more step and I can reach you.
He gets up and runs.

lines.zh: 蹄踩落叶，一点声音都没有。
lines.en: My hooves cross the leaves without a sound.
He turns and puts his back to a trunk.
That trunk is too thick.
The trunk is too thick. A pity.

lines.zh: 我把角压低，对准你胸口。
lines.en: I level my antlers at your chest.
And go over, step by step.

lines.zh: 角尖已经对准你的腰了。
lines.en: My antler tips are level with your flank.
I lower my head and charge.
I drive my antlers in.
He blocks and falls back.
My antlers hook you and fling you at a trunk.
That one found his ribs.
He goes down into the leaves.

lines.zh: 欧兰伍德的林子，是我的。
lines.en: The Ouranwood is mine.
My forehooves come down hard.
He rolls out from under them.
I turn again.
He gets up and runs.
Running, I'm faster.
I pound through the leaves after him.
There's a tree ahead of him.
He goes around the tree.
I didn't go round it.
I only dip my head.
He grabs my antlers.
I wrench my head and throw him off.
He lands and rolls twice.
I stand there, breathing loudly.

lines.zh: 我站在欧兰伍德的深处。
lines.en: I stand deep in the Ouranwood.
The trees here are older than elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我身上的力气，也是这里给的。
lines.en: The speed in me comes from here too.
I try two steps of a run.
I reach the treeline fast.
I stop and look back.

lines.zh: 欧兰伍德森林里，我睁开眼。
lines.en: In Ouranwood Forest I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 我生在这片鹿群里，守着这条路。
lines.en: I was born to this herd, and I keep this path.
I walk back slowly.
The leaves sound under each step.

lines.zh: 欧兰伍德的鹿，走得很慢。
lines.en: An Ouranwood deer walks very slowly.
Because I know how fast I can be.
Fire catches my antlers and I shake my head.

lines.zh: 我从坡上翻下去，角磕在石头上。
lines.en: I tumble down the slope and my antlers strike stone.

lines.zh: 水没过我的背，我往上游。
lines.en: Water covers my back and I strike for the surface.

lines.zh: 炸响把我掀到树下，我倒不过来。
lines.en: The blast throws me under a tree and I can't right myself.
An arrow lodges in my antler.
A light binds my legs.
The grass in the wood is all gone.

lines.zh: 雷打在树上，我整身都绷紧。
lines.en: Lightning strikes a tree and I go rigid.

lines.zh: 脚下没有落叶，也没有土。
lines.en: No leaves below, and no soil.
